Lethia Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-l1.htm

Lethia Harriett Coker, daughter of John Clayton Coker and Phoebe CARNEY was born on 22 August 1912 in Dover, Kent Co., DE. She married Hopewell Carter Jr., son of Hopewell Umphrey Carter and Sarah Ridgeway on 27 May, 1929. They moved to Cumberland Co., NJ. where she and Hopewell had the following children: Leroy Carter (12 Dec.1929- 14 July 1987) Perry Walton Carter (26 Dec.1930- ) married Eugenia Gillick John Clayton Carter (1932- ) married Christine Harris Donald Carter (20 April 1936- ) married Bessie Bennet Evelyn Carter (1 Oct.1939- ) married Burt Schroeder Lethia died in Bridgeton, Cumberland Co., NJ on 5 November, 1986. Hopewell died on 30 October 1967. Both are buried at Fernwood Memorial Park in Bridgeton, Cumberland Co., NJ.
